name: Amagase Tomomi
source:
Born into a wealthy family, she is orphaned by an unfortunate accident and blames herself for not saving them. She willingly enrols into St. Estella Academy and is a member of the A-class in the third year at the start of the game. Extremely polite and charming to all regardless of age and status.

Tomomi looks up to the existence of the witch and her powers hence she forms and leads the unofficial club "Garden of Black Lilies" (黒百合の園) with other like-minded students. 

[Spoiler] A talented pianist supported by her parents, she was on her way to a competition when a landslide claimed her parents' lives while she survived having been thrown to safety shortly before her parents were engulfed in debris. The memory of the event meant Tomomi never played the piano again after that day. Because Tomomi always blamed herself for not being able to do more to save them despite being within arm's reach, her encounter with Shirase grants her psycho-kinetic supernatural powers which she practises in the presence of her club members in the hope that it will give her greater control. Yukito is invited to join the club partly to buy his silence after his unexpected witnessing of lesbian sex between Tomomi and a first-year student suspected of witch powers by Yanagi and partly to give the other club members the opportunity to engage in stress-busting sex acts centred around the club's sole male member. [/Spoiler]
